name: wbfm
label: FM broadcast (mono)
description: Wideband FM receiver authored as one cross-env doc. The node half reads 2.4 MS/s IQ off an RTL-SDR (or any Soapy device with a matching `args` string) and a Channelizer pulls a 240 kS/s VFO to baseband. The `chan.out → decim.in` wire crosses the environment boundary; `env_split` auto-inserts a `WsBridgeTx`/`WsBridgeRx` pair at load time and deterministically allocates a `stream_id` starting at `CROSS_ENV_STREAM_BASE` (1000). The browser half does a 5× decimation to 48 kHz, runs a phase-discriminator FM demod, and feeds the AudioSink ring. Stereo pilot + L-R + RDS would widen the baseband and land as a separate preset.
